# FileAttachment

<!-- Generated from the doc comments in the library. Do not edit this file. -->

A file embedded into a generated PDF as an associated file (PDF 2.0 §7.11.4 / ISO 19005-3 for PDF/A-3). The engine writes it as an `/EmbeddedFile` stream referenced from a `/Filespec` in the document's `/Names /EmbeddedFiles` name tree, and lists the filespec in the catalog's `/AF` array so conforming readers surface it.

Attaching a file only affects generated documents; it does not read or modify an existing PDF (that is the separate document-operations feature).

Namespace `BonniePDF`.

## Constructors

```csharp
new FileAttachment(string fileName, byte[] content, AttachmentRelationship relationship = AttachmentRelationship.Unspecified, string mediaType = null)
```

## Properties

- [`Content`](#content): The raw bytes of the file.
- [`CreationDate`](#creationdate): The file's creation timestamp, written to the embedded-file stream's `/Params /CreationDate`.
- [`Description`](#description): A human-readable description, written as the filespec's `/Desc`.
- [`FileName`](#filename): The file name shown to the user and stored in the filespec's `/F` and `/UF` entries (e.g. `"invoice.xml"`).
- [`MediaType`](#mediatype): The MIME media type of the file (e.g. `"text/xml"`), written as the embedded-file stream's `/Subtype`.
- [`ModificationDate`](#modificationdate): The file's modification timestamp, written to the embedded-file stream's `/Params /ModDate`.
- [`Relationship`](#relationship): The relationship of this file to the document, written as `/AFRelationship`.

### `Content`

A human-readable description, written as the filespec's `/Desc`. Optional.

### `FileName`

```csharp
string FileName { get; set; }
```

The file name shown to the user and stored in the filespec's `/F` and `/UF` entries (e.g. `"invoice.xml"`). Required.

### `MediaType`

```csharp
string MediaType { get; set; }
```

The MIME media type of the file (e.g. `"text/xml"`), written as the embedded-file stream's `/Subtype`. Optional but recommended; PDF/A-3 and e-invoicing validators expect it.

### `ModificationDate`

```csharp
DateTimeOffset? ModificationDate { get; set; }
```

The file's modification timestamp, written to the embedded-file stream's `/Params /ModDate`. Optional.

### `Relationship`

```csharp
AttachmentRelationship Relationship { get; set; }
```

The relationship of this file to the document, written as `/AFRelationship`. Defaults to `Unspecified`.
